name: Alert
summary: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative rolls, and you can swap your rolled Initiative with a willing ally's.

name: Crafter
summary: Proficiency with three Artisan's Tools, a 20% discount on nonmagical items, and the ability to craft temporary gear on a Long Rest.

name: Healer
summary: Spend a Healer's Kit charge to let a nearby creature spend a Hit Die and heal extra HP; reroll 1s on healing dice.

name: Lucky
summary: Spend Luck Points (equal to Proficiency Bonus) to gain Advantage on your own d20 Test or impose Disadvantage on an attack against you.

name: Magic Initiate (Cleric)
summary: Learn two Cleric cantrips and one 1st-level Cleric spell, castable once per Long Rest without a slot.

name: Magic Initiate (Druid)
summary: Learn two Druid cantrips and one 1st-level Druid spell, castable once per Long Rest without a slot.

name: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
summary: Learn two Wizard cantrips and one 1st-level Wizard spell, castable once per Long Rest without a slot.

name: Musician
summary: Proficiency with three Musical Instruments; play a song after a rest to grant Heroic Inspiration to allies who hear it.

name: Savage Attacker
summary: Once per turn on a hit, roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either result.

name: Skilled
summary: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Tavern Brawler
summary: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage, reroll 1s, and you can push a creature you hit 5 feet.

name: Tough
summary: Hit Point maximum increases by twice your level immediately, then by 2 extra every level thereafter.
